items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Walter had all my albums. In that voice, he said, “I’ve got all your albums.”

ctx.x: It’s really remarkable. Those faces were in front of the American public almost every day, and there you were.
I found out that Walter Cronkite and Mike Wallace were big jazz fans. Walter had all my albums. In that voice, he said, “I’ve got all your albums.” I was knocked out.
When did you write Evolution of the Blues.
